repriced.note: Harbor's recorded cost ($58.62) charged prompt-cache writes as plain input and used a $0.20 Sonnet 5.5 cache-read rate (Anthropic lists $0.10). Repriced from each trial's token usage at the catalog's $2 / $0.10 / $2.50 / $4 / $10 per million input / cache-read / 5-minute cache-write / 1-hour cache-write / output tokens: $53.93 (-8.0%). Still a list-price equivalent: the run used GitHub Copilot.

tokens.basis: Harbor per-trial input_tokens (includes cached), cache_tokens, output_tokens

notes: Six-hour agent timeout (override_timeout_sec=21600) on the fixed-QEMU TB2.1 snapshot; a modified evaluation, not a leaderboard-eligible configuration.

bench-run cohort on HF Jobs (Harbor b20373d6) with the published fast-agent-mcp 0.10.42 wheel; Claude Sonnet 5.5 (high reasoning) through GitHub Copilot. Zero whole-trial retries; fast-agent's own provider retries apply. Three infrastructure failures (a read timeout, two connection errors) were rerun as replacements; the originals are kept as evidence.
Safety stops: 16 trials ended with AgentSafetyStopError and score 0.

Cost shown is a list-rate estimate repriced from each trial's token usage (bench-run reprice, card-packs catalog 2026-10-10.1): Harbor's fast-agent adapter charged prompt-cache writes as plain input, and the run was priced with a $0.20 cache-read rate where Anthropic lists $0.10. Recorded $58.62; repriced $53.93 over the same 446 trials. The run used GitHub Copilot, so this is a list-price equivalent, not what Copilot billed. Some trials have model calls that reported no usage, so the total is a lower bound.
